content:
anya: Quick sync — I'm going to run a fuzzy-dedupe pass on prompt-bank v2 before we kick off the quant warmup for the new model bring-up. Goal is to remove near-duplicates that bias calibration and leak into golden sets.

mike: Why before quant? Won't dedupe shift distribution used for calibration?

anya: Yes, but that's why we do it first — we want the calibration corpus to reflect the deduped distribution. Also prevents golden leakage.

liam: Proposed dedupe params (initial): `--sim-threshold 0.88 --min-tokens 6 --tokenizer gpt2`. Local command:```
./scripts/dedupe.py --input s3://redwood/prompt-bank/v2.jsonl --output s3://redwood/prompt-bank/v2-dedup.jsonl --sim 0.88 --min-tokens 6
```

omar: Heads-up for labelers: any prompts flagged as AMBIGUOUS (~3.2k expected) should go to the extended queue, not fast review. @labeler-team

bri: We can relabel in ~2 days if we prioritize high-entropy + quant-sensitive items. Send a prioritized list.

anya: I'll snapshot the current golden IDs before dedupe and push to evals so we can run regression comparisons.

eval-bot: snapshot created s3://redwood/goldshots/2345600000-snapshot.json sha256:abc123...

liam: Quant warmup plan: run int8 per-tensor (PACT) and int4 per-channel calibration. Metrics: perplexity, NLL, and hallucination/regression on golden. We'll also compute exact-match and BLEU on structured outputs.

mike: Add automatic alert: exact-match drop >3% OR BLEU drop >4% triggers rollback candidate.

anya: Also want to include a small sampling of templated/instruction prompts (structured tool calls) since dedupe collapses templates and that frequently surfaces regressions.

dev-bot: Provisioned test pool: 4x A100-sim nodes for calibration. Job queued: quant-warmup-2345600100 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

omar: Routing note: ambiguous -> labeler-extended queue; everything else -> standard labeler.

bri: We'll publish a short guide: "Prefer literal interpretation; mark Ambiguous when intent unclear; include examples".

anya: Request: freeze prompt-bank tagging for 48h while we iterate on dedupe -> quant loop. Anyone object?

mike: No objections. :thumbsup:

liam: Starting dedupe run now, will post logs.

liam: log snippet: `Found 312,187 prompts -> 298,903 after dedupe (5.2% removed)`

anya: Great. Once dedupe output is stable I'll push prioritized ambiguous set to @bri and trigger calibration.

mike: Thanks everyone — please flag any weird edgecases (code snippets, multi-turn instruction templates) so we don't accidentally remove needed variants.

anya: Will do.
